title: Fabulous Sunset Cruise - Highly Recommend
text: Our sunset cruise was incredible! It was such a beautiful evening. Marcos was an awesome Captain, who made our trip so enjoyable and relaxing. We loved that it was private with only our group of 6 on the cruise.  When we arrived back at the dock, Martin, the owner, was there to welcome us back. We highly recommend AURA Sailing.
author: Sara S

title: Beautiful experience
text: A very pleasant sea outing despite the big waves on the return! Thanks again to our captain Marcos!
author: EvaQ109

title: Must do boating in Barcelona
text: We had such a wonderful sunset experience! Communication was good on WhatsApp regarding the booking details, the directions to meet the boat were clear, and Captain Marcos was terrific! We booked the same day and they proceeded with the trip even with just two of us. The board was comfortable and the snacks and drinks were a lovely treat! A nice alternative to the busy city - quiet, peaceful and calming. We couldn’t have asked for better way to start our trip to Barcelona. Thank you again Marcos for a wonderful evening!
author: Kristen_S

title: Best times
text: Absolutely great experience! Fun fun fun, very layback sailing and then sunset! Good drinks , Lis was great captain and very layback
author: 969dmitris

title: Wonderful Evening Sailing Experience with Aura Sailing Barcelona!
text:
I joined the evening sailing tour with Aura Sailing Barcelona in mid-October, and it was absolutely fantastic! About 24 hours before the trip, they sent me a detailed guideline with all the information I needed — very organized and professional.
The boat was beautiful and comfortable, and we started exactly on time at 17:30. The crew was extremely welcoming and friendly, making everyone feel relaxed from the beginning. Even though there was a bit of wind, the two-hour sail was a phenomenal and truly relaxing experience. Watching Barcelona from the sea at sunset was just magical.

title: This is a must do experience.
text: This was a fantastic day sailing trip. Lisa was friendly and knowledgeable. The snacks were wonderful, we had Cava to celebrate me being cancer free. I couldn't recommend this experience any more, it's a must go! Now we can all say we sailed the Mediterranean.
